package librarytree_test

import (
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 "reflect"
 "sync"
 "testing"
 lint "zabaplint"
)

func prime(t *testing.T) *lint.Checker {
 t.Helper()
 raw,err:=os.ReadFile("files.json");if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 var files []lint.File
 if err=json.Unmarshal(raw,&files);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 c:=new(lint.Checker)
 c.Prime(files,nil,`{"syntax":{"version":"open-abap","errorNamespace":"."},"rules":{"parser_error":true,"check_syntax":true}}`)
 return c
}
func walk(n lint.Node, fn func(lint.Node)) { fn(n);for _,c:=range n.Children{walk(c,fn)} }
func TestOutline(t *testing.T) {
 c:=prime(t)
 files,found:=c.Tree("CLAS","zoutline")
 if !found||len(files)!=4{t.Fatalf("class files: %v %d",found,len(files))}
 want:=[]string{"zoutline.clas.locals_def.abap","zoutline.clas.locals_imp.abap","zoutline.clas.abap","zoutline.clas.testclasses.abap"}
 for i,f:=range files {if f.Filename!=want[i]{t.Fatal(f.Filename,want[i])}}
 kinds:=map[string]int{}
 walk(*files[2].Structure,func(n lint.Node){
  kinds[n.Kind]++
  if n.FirstStatement!=nil{t.Fatal("unexpected FirstStatement",n)}
  if n.Statement {
   if n.Children!=nil||len(n.Tokens)==0{t.Fatal("statement shape",n)}
   if n.Start!=n.Tokens[0].Start||n.End!=n.Tokens[len(n.Tokens)-1].End{t.Fatal("bounds",n)}
  } else if n.Tokens!=nil||len(n.Children)==0 {t.Fatal("structure shape",n)}
 })
 for _,k:=range []string{"ClassDefinition","PublicSection","ProtectedSection","PrivateSection","MethodDef","Method","DataBegin","DataEnd"}{if kinds[k]==0{t.Fatal("missing kind",k,kinds)}}
 if files[2].Statements[0].Start!=(lint.Pos{Row:1,Col:1}){t.Fatal("coordinates")}
 last:=files[2].Statements[len(files[2].Statements)-1]
 if last.End!=(lint.Pos{Row:18,Col:10}){t.Fatal("exclusive end",last.End)}
 interfaces,found:=c.Tree("INTF","ZOUTLINE")
 if !found||len(interfaces)!=1||interfaces[0].Filename!="zoutline.intf.abap"{t.Fatal("interface sequencing",interfaces,found)}
 programs,found:=c.Tree("PROG","ZOUTLINE")
 if !found||len(programs)!=2||programs[0].Filename!="zoutline.prog.abap"{t.Fatal(programs,found)}
 kinds=map[string]int{}
 for _,n:=range programs[0].Statements{kinds[n.Kind]++}
 for _,k:=range []string{"Initialization","StartOfSelection","EndOfSelection"}{if kinds[k]!=1{t.Fatal(k,kinds)}}
 bad,_:=c.Tree("PROG","ZBAD")
 if len(bad)!=1||bad[0].Structure!=nil||len(bad[0].Statements)!=3||bad[0].Statements[1].Kind!="Unknown"{t.Fatal("failed parse",bad)}
 empty,_:=c.Tree("PROG","ZEMPTY")
 if empty[0].Structure==nil||empty[0].Structure.Start!=(lint.Pos{})||empty[0].Structure.End!=(lint.Pos{})||len(empty[0].Statements)!=0{t.Fatal("empty structure",empty)}
 if files,found:=c.Tree("DEVC","ZOTHER");!found||files==nil||len(files)!=0{t.Fatal(files,found)}
 for _,typ:=range []string{"clas","MISSING"}{if f,found:=c.Tree(typ,"ZOUTLINE");found||f!=nil{t.Fatal(f,found)}}
 if i,found:=c.CheckObject("CLAS","missing");found||i!=nil{t.Fatal(i,found)}
 byFile:=c.Check("zbad.prog.abap")
 byObject,found:=c.CheckObject("PROG","zbad")
 if !found||len(byObject)==0||!reflect.DeepEqual(byFile,byObject){t.Fatal(byFile,byObject,found)}
}
func TestPragmasAndUpdate(t *testing.T){
 c:=prime(t)
 files,_:=c.Tree("PROG","ZOUTLINE")
 if got:=lint.ConcatTokens(files[0].Statements[1].Tokens);got!="DATA value TYPE i ."{t.Fatal(got)}
 if got:=lint.ConcatTokens(files[0].Statements[5].Tokens);got!="WRITE / value,"{t.Fatal(got)}
 if got:=lint.ConcatTokens(files[0].Statements[6].Tokens);got!="WRITE / '##literal'."{t.Fatal(got)}
 pragmas,_:=c.Tree("PROG","ZPRAGMA")
 pragmaStatements:=pragmas[0].Statements
 if !pragmaStatements[0].Tokens[0].Pragma||lint.ConcatTokens(pragmaStatements[0].Tokens)!="."||lint.ConcatTokens(pragmaStatements[1].Tokens)!=""{t.Fatal("pragma identity",pragmaStatements)}
 original:=files[0].Statements[0].Tokens[0].Str
 files[0].Statements[0].Tokens[0].Str="changed copy"
 again,_:=c.Tree("PROG","ZOUTLINE")
 if again[0].Statements[0].Tokens[0].Str!=original{t.Fatal("tree aliases core")}
 raw:="REPORT zoutline.\nWRITE 'updated'."
 before:=c.Stats();c.Update("zoutline.prog.abap",&raw)
 updated,_:=c.Tree("PROG","ZOUTLINE")
 if len(updated[0].Statements)!=2||lint.ConcatTokens(updated[0].Statements[1].Tokens)!="WRITE 'updated'."{t.Fatal(updated)}
 if c.Stats().ParseRuns!=before.ParseRuns+1{t.Fatal("lazy parse stats",c.Stats(),before)}
 if lint.ConcatTokens(again[0].Statements[0].Tokens)!="REPORT zoutline."{t.Fatal("snapshot changed")}
 c.Update("zoutline.prog.abap",nil);c.Update("zoutline.prog.screen_0100.abap",nil)
 if f,found:=c.Tree("PROG","ZOUTLINE");found||f!=nil{t.Fatal(f,found)}
}
func TestConcurrentReaders(t *testing.T){
 c:=prime(t);other:=prime(t)
 var wg sync.WaitGroup
 for _,checker:=range []*lint.Checker{c,other}{wg.Go(func(){for i:=0;i<3;i++{checker.Tree("CLAS","ZOUTLINE");checker.CheckObject("PROG","ZBAD")}})}
 wg.Wait()
}
